note: Per-trophy cited steps, disputes and watch flags for v3. Every step carries at least one source number from sources.json; every source number cited was read on 20 Nov 2026 and supports that step. 'guide' (the full paragraph) still lives in trophies.json and is unchanged. Names and official descriptions are NOT in this file — they live in trophies.json and were verified 55/55.

disputes.a: The Platinum is the final trophy on PlayStation, worth 300 PSN points. On Xbox it is the final 100% achievement, worth 0G, since the other 54 achievements add up to the full 1,000 Gamerscore.
disputes.b: EGamers and GTABase call the Xbox version the Mythic achievement instead of a 0G achievement.
disputes.call: Same trophy, different platform label — PlayStation calls it the Platinum, Xbox lists it as the final achievement.
disputes.q: What is the Platinum called on Xbox?

trophies.inShort: The finish line, not a task — it unlocks itself when the other 54 are done.

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies — the Platinum pops on its own when the last one lands.
If it has not popped, use the tracker on this page: the one trophy still open is the one to chase.
Do the 100% checklist (A Long Road) last: most trophies finish on the way to it.
On Xbox the same trophy is the final 100% achievement (0G, since the other 54 add up to the full 1,000).

trophies.inShort: Finish the opening mission. It pops on its own.

steps.t: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing — Jason's first job.
It pops during the story; no side objective is needed.
It is the first trophy most players earn — the opening mission itself is the trigger.

disputes.a: Down to Earth is the 14th of 22 Chapter 1 missions (KeenGamer walkthrough, PowerPyx walkthrough, Video Games Chronicle, Push Square).
disputes.b: Beebom counts it 13th and GTABay 16th — their lists count the Prologue and optional missions differently.
disputes.call: The trigger mission is the same either way (Down to Earth, Brian's smuggling flight). Only the numbering differs.
disputes.q: Where does Down to Earth fall in Chapter 1?

trophies.inShort: Finish Chapter 1. Do the balcony meditation first.

steps.t: Play through all 22 Chapter 1 missions, ending with Discharge Time.
Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house — it is the one interaction tied to the possibly-missable meditation trophy.
Keep a manual save at the chapter boundary — there is no mission replay.

trophies.watch: Do the balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1 — see Positive Mental Attitude.

disputes.a: T**s (two asterisks) — KeenGamer, Push Square, Exophase and OutputLag.
disputes.call: The console list shows two asterisks; this guide uses T**s.
disputes.q: One asterisk or two in the trophy name?

trophies.inShort: Finish Chapter 2. The name is censored in trophy lists.

steps.t: Finish Chapter 2 in full — the trophy pops at the chapter close.
Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene — do not worry if it does not pop instantly.
Keep a manual save at the chapter boundary — there is no mission replay.

trophies.inShort: Finish Chapter 3. Start scanning and studying as you travel.

steps.t: Finish Chapter 3.
Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene.
Start scanning unfamiliar vehicles with the WAiNK app and studying animals with binoculars as you travel — both feed the 100% checklist later.

trophies.inShort: Finish Chapter 4. Vaults open near the end of it.

steps.t: Finish Chapter 4.
Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene.
The big bank-vault robberies unlock around here through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is — leave the eight large vaults until that mission opens them.

trophies.inShort: Finish the final mission. The cleanup starts after the credits.

steps.t: Finish the final story mission.
Keep a manual save from just before the final mission — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
After the credits you keep free roam of Leonida, and the 100% checklist opens in Progress > Stats — most of the Platinum grind happens after this point.

trophies.inShort: Complete Breakfast Run. It also unlocks partner switching.

steps.t: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run.
Partner switching opens right after Breakfast Run, in Chapter 2 — you can then switch between Jason and Lucia and call the other one in as a partner.
Like all story trophies it unlocks by playing the mission through — no side objective needed.

trophies.inShort: Complete The Cartel Heist.

steps.t: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist.
Treat heist missions as practice for the robbery trophies in Stage 4 — the same escape-and-lose-the-heat loop applies.
The Cartel Heist is a story mission — it cannot be missed on a playthrough that reaches the finale.

trophies.inShort: Complete Child's Play.

steps.t: Complete the story mission Child's Play.
Unmissable as long as you play the story to the end.
Child's Play is a Chapter 2 story mission.

trophies.inShort: Complete Headliners.

steps.t: Complete the story mission Headliners.
Another story-automatic trophy — it cannot be missed on a playthrough that reaches the finale.
Story trophies pop as you play — no side objective is needed.

trophies.inShort: Complete VCIA Takedown. Learn the runways for later.

steps.t: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport.
Learn the runway layout here — the airport is also the scene of the Catch Me If You Can trophy, so note where the passenger planes dock.
The airport's passenger planes dock at boarding bridges — note gates E3 and E4 for later.

trophies.inShort: Complete Operation Savage Glory.

steps.t: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory.
The last of the named-mission story trophies; after it, only the finale stands between you and the post-story cleanup.
Keep a manual save from just before the final mission — there is no mission replay.

disputes.a: Around 200 hours — PowerPyx, KeenGamer, GTABase and OutputLag all put the Platinum at roughly 200 hours.
disputes.b: Up to 300 hours or more — Push Square, whose guide is marked work in progress and counts slower play.
disputes.call: 200 hours is the consensus of the dedicated trophy guides; Push Square's guide is still WIP.

trophies.inShort: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist — 35 requirements, not everything.

steps.t: Finish the story — the checklist only appears after the credits, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts.

Work the story and tasks block first: 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 vaults, and the fencing totals ($100k narcotics, $100k jewelry, $250k marked bills, $200k vehicles).

Then the exploration block: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 flamingos, 42 shooting-range golds, 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges.
Finish the discovery block: 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons found.
Nothing on the checklist is permanently missable — everything can still be done in free roam after the story.

trophies.inShort: Complete 250 stunts. The checklist wants 300, so keep going.

steps.t: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida — stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count.
The 100% checklist wants 300 of 397 (130 stunt jumps, 202 under the bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps), so keep stunting past this trophy.
Stunt opportunities are everywhere on highways and ramps; the counter runs in the background while you travel.
You can see all the stunts you have discovered on the map under Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.inShort: Try all nine activity types once.

steps.t: Try each of the nine activity types at least once — races, shooting ranges, fishing, arcade games, pool, mini golf, basketball, drone races and the rest.
Do this early: it is a fast Bronze and it teaches you which activities feed the 100% checklist.
Races and shooting ranges count as two of the nine — both are needed for other trophies anyway.

trophies.inShort: Gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.

steps.t: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — 18 at Griffin, 24 at Rodgers Ranch.
There are two shooting ranges with 42 gold medals between them.
This is one of the hardest trophies and it is also required in full for 100%, so budget real practice time.
Learn one range's timing first, then repeat the pattern — accuracy and speed both matter, and replays are free.

trophies.inShort: Win a drone race at all 14 locations.

steps.t: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations.
The 100% checklist separately wants all 42 drone time trials, so fly every course twice: once to win the race, once to beat the trial time.
Learn the gates before pushing speed.
Win at least one race at each location — the 14 locations are the same ones the time trials use.

trophies.inShort: Win 20 different races. Do Yago's timed race when it appears.

steps.t: Win 20 different races across Leonida.
The 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 unique races won, so this trophy lands on the way — vary the race types instead of repeating one favourite.
Do Yago's timed race the moment it appears — the Chapter 3 race in Yago's street-racing strand carries an hourglass icon and the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks. Save first, then race.
Keep a different vehicle ready for each discipline.

trophies.watch: Yago's timed Chapter 3 race appears once — do it when it appears.

trophies.inShort: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps.t: Take Cal's fishing challenge when it appears.
Watch the line tension instead of mashing, and reel steadily when the fish runs.
Fishing raises Focus too — each fish you land adds about 10% to the Focus meter.

trophies.inShort: Complete one arcade game.

steps.t: Complete any one arcade game — any of the four in-game games counts.
Pick the shortest cabinet you find and finish a full run.
The 100% checklist also wants you to play all four video games, so note which cabinets you have tried.

trophies.inShort: Finish Andy's strand, ending with Puff Puff Pass.

steps.t: Finish Andy's stranger strand through to his final mission, Puff Puff Pass.
Stranger strands unlock as you explore — check the map for stranger icons after each chapter and clear them before moving on.
Andy's strand is one of the five named-character finals; each has its own trophy.

trophies.inShort: Finish Kenton's strand. His treasure sets count toward 100%.

steps.t: Finish Kenton's strand to his final mission.
Kenton also ties into treasure sets — five of his seven sets count toward 100% — so pick up his collectibles while his missions take you around the map.
Treasure hunting (Island Dreams) ties into Kenton's strand — five of seven sets plus all 33 underwater discoveries count toward 100%.
Kenton becomes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but reappears between Chapters 2 and 3, so he is not missable — all his quests are still available after the story.

trophies.inShort: Finish Billy's strand. Keep a fast bike ready.

steps.t: Finish Billy's stranger strand through to his final mission.
Billy's missions are bike-heavy — keep a fast bike in your garage so you are not hunting for one mid-strand.
Billy's strand is bike-heavy throughout, not just at the end — the bike is the strand's tool, not a one-off.

disputes.a: The five named-character finals count toward the 8 strands, so you need three more strands beyond them (the reading this guide used in v2).
disputes.b: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands do NOT count — only some optional questlines count, because those three have their own trophies.
disputes.call: Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish, and do not assume the named finals count.
disputes.q: Do the five named-character finals count toward the 8 strands?

trophies.inShort: Complete 8 qualifying stranger strands. Check the counter after each one.

steps.t: Complete eight qualifying stranger mission strands across Leonida.
Only some optional questlines count — check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish.
Sweep the map icons between chapters rather than leaving them all for the endgame.
Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands have their own trophies — see the dispute panel before counting on them.

trophies.watch: Some stranger strands are only offered for a while — sweep map icons between chapters.

trophies.inShort: Finish Randy's strand.

steps.t: Finish Randy's stranger strand through to his final mission.
Randy's work leans on supply runs — stock up on ammo and armour before his later missions, which escalate quickly.

trophies.inShort: Finish Tyrone's strand.

steps.t: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand through to his final mission.
Clear Tyrone's strand before the finale if you can — stranger missions are easier to track while the story is still feeding you map icons.

count.label: meditations
count.note: 15 of 18 count toward 100%; all 18 count toward the trophy.

disputes.a: PowerPyx, Bloxodes and TheGamersHub: it is UNCONFIRMED whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is required. The balcony spot is not marked like the rest, and the final Ascent meditation may count +2, so the trophy may be earnable without it.
disputes.b: Beebom, GameTrek and OutputLag: all 18 are required and the balcony counts — miss it and the trophy is lost for that save.
disputes.call: Do the balcony meditation in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. The safe move covers both readings.
disputes.q: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation required for the trophy?

disputes.a: The 100% checklist needs 15 of 18 meditations (PowerPyx 100% guide).
disputes.call: 15 counts for 100%, but do all 18 for the trophy.

trophies.inShort: Meditate at all 18 spots. Do the Chapter 1 balcony first — it is the only one that can disappear.

steps.t: After the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning — she mentions meditating — follow her to the balcony and accept, and complete that balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1.
Meditate at the other 9 spots with both characters: each outdoor spot counts twice, once with Jason and once with Lucia, so bring your partner every time.

The 10 spots: Jason's House (1), Smooth Sand (2), Swamp (2), Worn Stone (2), Red Rocks (2), Water Wheel (2), Jutting Cliff (2), Waterfall (2), Seaside (2), Ascent Mountain (1) — 18 meditations in total.
Ascent Mountain only appears on the map after every other spot is done — it is the last meditation.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; the 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, but this trophy needs all 18.
Keep a manual save from Chapter 1 until the trophy pops — nobody has confirmed the balcony meditation is strictly required, so do it anyway.

trophies.watch: Chapter 1 only — the balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1.

trophies.inShort: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His target decks count toward 100%.

steps.t: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — his hunting questline is Jason-only and runs through target decks.
A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.
All 15 of Bret's Target Deck objectives are required for 100%, so treat his hunts as checklist progress, not a detour.
Study animals with binoculars first; the study count matters separately for 100% (100 of 255 animals).

trophies.inShort: Complete 3 card sets. The checklist wants 15 of 18.

steps.t: Complete three full collectible card sets.
The 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets (480 cards in all), so three is only the start — collect cards whenever you pass a spawn.
480 cards in 18 sets exist in total; 15 sets are needed for 100%.
Trade duplicates rather than hunting single cards across the map.

trophies.inShort: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app.

steps.t: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations — hold D-Pad Up to pull out the app, then look at a vehicle and scan it with R1/RB.
Open the app on every new vehicle and landmark you meet from the very first hour — the 100% checklist needs the same 100 scans.
You can also scan aircraft and boats — they count too.

trophies.inShort: Complete 50 of 80 challenges. The checklist wants 70.

steps.t: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges — eight categories of ten, listed under Progress > Challenges.
The 100% checklist wants 70, so pick the 50 easiest first and leave the hardest ten entirely alone.
Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges; many complete on their own while you play.

trophies.inShort: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner — and get clear of the heat zone.

steps.t: Get a four-star wanted level with your partner beside you — robbing a bank vault with your partner does it straight away.
Escape the heat: the trophy only pops once you are out of the red heat zone — getting out of the flashing search area is not enough.
A fast car, a planned route out of the search zone, and no stopping to fight are what make this pop.

trophies.inShort: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing the heat.

steps.t: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you.
If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks — keep moving and do not let the heat clear.
Plan a route past three close shops and hit them in quick succession; the trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop.

trophies.inShort: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan everything — the checklist wants 200.

steps.t: Discover 100 vehicles — scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive.
The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep going past 100.
Scan traffic as you drive — every new vehicle you pass is a discovery.

trophies.inShort: Take down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus.

steps.t: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim: press L3 and R3 while aiming.
Wait for a crowded fight — a gang shootout at an illegal operation — and use an assault rifle on a group of gang enemies. Police, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count.
Each fish you land adds about 10% to the Focus meter, and Adrenaline extends Focus — top the meter up before the fight.

trophies.inShort: Steal a docked passenger plane at VCIA and fly 1 km clear.

steps.t: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work; planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count.
Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off.
The trophy is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.

trophies.inShort: Get into a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station and use it.

steps.t: Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on Goose Key at the bottom of the Keys.
Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.
Approach with a fast escape vehicle parked nearby — the base response is heavy.

trophies.inShort: Rob a jewelry store unseen — Snap Gun on the back door, safe code from the note.

steps.t: Yasmani's Chapter 3 job, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies.
Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm.
Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target.

trophies.inShort: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The checklist needs all 8.

steps.t: Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4.
Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open — you cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner.
Vault jobs give you a four-star wanted level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together.
The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults, so five is a milestone, not the end.

trophies.inShort: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat zone.

steps.t: Armored trucks run set routes around the city — ram one to a stop or block it, crack it open, grab the cash.
Break line of sight before the police box you in; the trophy only pops once you are out of the red heat zone. A bike is the best getaway here.
Learn one truck route and wait for it — the trucks run set routes, so the ambush can be planned.

trophies.inShort: Explore all of Leonida.

steps.t: Explore all of Leonida and uncover the complete map — drive, fly and sail the edges; the map fills in as you travel.
Combine this with WAiNK scans and stunt runs instead of making dedicated map trips.
The far corners and islands are the parts people miss.

trophies.inShort: Rob one illegal operation from each of the nine gangs.

steps.t: Rob at least one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs — keep a checklist of which gangs you have hit.
The 100% checklist wants 39 gang operations in total, so this is a down-payment on that.
Gang operations get marked by yellow icons on the map when you enter their location.

trophies.inShort: Method unconfirmed — cocktail on Ocean Beach, per the description only.

steps.t: UNCONFIRMED (20 Nov 2026): the description points to enjoying a cocktail overlooking Ocean Beach — try ordering a drink at a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach and lingering at the view.
Treat any single-source method as a rumour until a second source confirms it. Do not burn a save on this one.

trophies.watch: Method unconfirmed — do not trust a single-source method.

trophies.inShort: Method unconfirmed — drive out of a showroom, per the description only.

steps.t: UNCONFIRMED (20 Nov 2026): the hint is to smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — the old drive-through-the-window exit.
Try it with a sturdy car at a showroom, but the exact trigger is still being confirmed across sources, so verify before repeating.

trophies.watch: Method unconfirmed — do not trust a single-source method.

trophies.inShort: Steal the three key valuables at Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

steps.t: Steal the three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling (Kolt & Associates' bowling alley in Port Gellhorn) — the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the office safe, blown open with Sticky Bombs (buy them at Ammu-Nation first).
It unlocks in Chapter 2 via the optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which marks the alley automatically.
The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item — and you do not need all three in one visit: the operation respawns after a long while, so it is not missable.

trophies.inShort: Max Strength for both Jason and Lucia.

steps.t: Max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia — buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you.
Gym work, melee and heavy lifting raise Strength over time.
Switch characters when one caps out so neither is left behind.

trophies.inShort: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. It finishes on its own.

steps.t: Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile — robberies, crimes, escapes and story choices all feed it.
Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind.
It will finish on its own during a full 100% run; check the profile counter in-game to see how close you are.

trophies.inShort: Method unconfirmed — 'Second time's the charm' is the only hint.

steps.t: UNCONFIRMED (20 Nov 2026): the only published hint is 'Second time's the charm', which suggests failing something once and succeeding on the retry.
No source has confirmed what that something is — do not chase guesses; check back after more players report it.

trophies.watch: Method unconfirmed — do not trust a single-source method.

trophies.inShort: Method unconfirmed — reads like a rare random event.

steps.t: UNCONFIRMED (20 Nov 2026): the only published hint is 'What the hell just happened?', which reads like a rare random event or easter egg.
No source has confirmed a trigger — leave this one for last and watch for new reports rather than grinding blind.

trophies.watch: Method unconfirmed — do not trust a single-source method.

trophies.inShort: Method being confirmed — melee drive-by that bowls a target over.

steps.t: METHOD BEING CONFIRMED (20 Nov 2026): bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — the working reading is a melee strike from a moving vehicle that knocks a target down like a bowling pin.
Try it at the bowling alley area, but the precise method is still being confirmed across sources.

trophies.watch: Method unconfirmed — do not trust a single-source method.

trophies.inShort: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through contacts.

steps.t: Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs — fence them by selling to your contacts.
The $250,000 total is cumulative. The 100% checklist needs the same $250,000 fenced, so this trophy and the checklist finish together.
Bank the bills regularly instead of hoarding them.

trophies.inShort: Spend $100,000 across all shops.

steps.t: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, food and gear all count, and the total is cumulative.
Do not force it early: by the time you have bought the garages, weapons and ammo for a full 100% run, this will already be close.
The garages alone cost about $160,000 — buying them takes you most of the way there.

trophies.inShort: Buy all 8 garages (~$160,000). Story garages do not count.

steps.t: Buy the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000.
Garages the story gives you do not count.
Save for these through the story — robberies and fencing fund them — and buy each garage as soon as you can afford it.

trophies.inShort: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app.

steps.t: The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register.
From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray.
Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
